data.body: rebar-debug Phase 2 / Step 4 RED oracle proven: added a held-out in-process workflow contract with two bounded fixtures. The first injects the real typed token-cap failure at the aggregate completion agent boundary and requires recovery through a fresh tool-free structured finalizer returning all six criterion records. The second makes recovery exhaust too and requires a typed fail-closed error plus actionable trace/request/tool diagnostics in the dedicated gate-error record; it explicitly rejects the current `raise max_tokens` advice. Exact gate command: `rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_token_recovery_heldout.py`. Result on unfixed origin/main: 2 collected, 2 executed, 2 FAILED for the expected reasons — the first stops at `decide@then/verify` after the first typed length error with no recovery call; the second error lacks recovery/trace diagnostics. Collection-only confirmed both exact nodes are collected and neither is skipped/xfail. The test will now be removed from the fixer worktree and held out until implementation is complete.
